intended_use: Prepare and route post-discharge follow-up tasks; no autonomous diagnosis or treatment decision.

gates.question: Is the intended use narrow, documented and accepted by the clinical owner?
Are legal basis, data minimisation, processor terms and DPIA screening documented?
gates.suggested_next_step: Generate the reusable privacy evidence pack from the Trust Passport.

gates.question: Has hospital IT/security reviewed identity, access, logging, encryption and rollback?
Have affected staff and, where applicable, employee representatives been involved early?
Has the intended purpose been assessed for medical-device / other health-sector regulatory implications?
Are pilot boundaries, accountable humans, stop conditions and success metrics approved?

ready_when: all blocking gates are approved or explicitly not applicable
notes: AI prepares evidence; authorised humans make approvals.
This example is an integration template, not a legal or clinical determination.
